content.text:
The drawing shows a carbon bearing Ph, N3 (azide), H, and an O–O–tBu group, so it is an α-azido perether: PhCH(N=[N+]=[N-])OOC(C)(C)C.

Other parts of the image are cut off: a partial structure at the left and a "+" sign at the right. The answer therefore covers only the fully visible molecule.

The central carbon has four substituents (Ph, H, N3, OOtBu) and is drawn with plain bonds, so no stereochemistry is assigned.

SMILES: CC(C)(C)OOC(N=[N+]=[N-])c1ccccc1
